snippet.title: Maziac indie game trailer
snippet.description:
This is a no-frills trailer for the only PC game I ever finished and released - Maziac. The game is actually fairly decent, if simplistic, and unreasonably hard. Written in Game Maker 5 (the one with incredibly slow software-driven graphics engine with excruciatingly sluggish alpha features), the game demonstrates some cool lighting effects  for a 2D platformer. It can be downloaded here: http://www.yoyogames.com/games/show/4

The project was started as a code experiment for another, as of yet unreleased game, and was essentially finished in a month or so. The goal was to prove to myself that I can actually finish a game, no matter how unambitious. It was then essentially abandoned for a year after my "publisher" refused to put up the game on their website due to an easter egg of questionable taste I was silly enough to include. Eventually, the game was finished and polished, questionable content removed, and "published" by EO Game Maker community.
